<!-- Generated by apps/docs/scripts/generate-component-api.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Split-pane markdown editor with local Markdown/React preview and optional Clicky-backed format previews. Hosts can pass `previewEndpoint` for the standard Clicky `format=` contract or `loadPreview` for custom conversion.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/MarkdownEditor.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { MarkdownEditor } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/data";
```
